conceptual_boundary.measures: The fraction of a fixed, independently mapped ice-free-support area that is repeatedly observable as non-snow/ice, non-water surface during austral-summer Landsat acquisitions in each frozen epoch.
does_not_measure: all deglaciated terrain outside the fixed Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory support
conceptual_boundary.prohibited_primary_label: new rock area unless independently validated as deglaciated rock

spatial_grid.support: nearest-neighbour projection of the frozen Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory ice-free support to a fixed local 30 m grid
spatial_grid.paired_support_rule: A grid cell enters site-level early-versus-late change only if it has at least the minimum valid observations in both epochs.

scene_selection: Reuse exactly the full pixel-QA scene selection: austral months, scene cloud <=80%, one lowest-cloud scene per year, at most five evenly spaced years per epoch.

per_scene_mask.note: Do not rely on QA_PIXEL clear bit 6 alone.

per_pixel_epoch_state.exposure_frequency: number of exposed observations / number of valid observations
sensitivities_frozen_now: any-exposed threshold >0 only as a high-sensitivity diagnostic
per_pixel_epoch_state.no_threshold_search: No additional exposure-frequency cutoff may be selected from demographic outcomes.

site_epoch_metric.primary: persistent-exposed area divided by paired observable AEI-support area
site_epoch_metric.secondary_area: persistent-exposed area in hectares on the paired support
site_epoch_metric.rate: change divided by frozen early-late epoch midpoint separation in years
site_epoch_metric.positive_direction: more summer-exposed breeding opportunity in the late epoch

beaufort.requirement: If Beaufort passes full pixel QA, the metric must indicate positive exposure change over the closest supported historical-to-2010/early-2010s comparison before demographic outcomes are joined.

sentinel2.principle: Compare recent Landsat exposure state with Sentinel-2 L2A snow/ice / bare-surface information where catalog support exists.
sentinel2.gate_status: diagnostic, not used to tune a demographic-favorable threshold

spectral_sensitivity.note: NDSI alone cannot be the primary classifier because Antarctic shade and clouds are known failure modes. A spectral sensitivity may be added only as a prespecified measurement check and cannot replace the QA-derived primary metric after demographic outcomes are seen.

requires: exposure metric computed without technical failure for the frozen eligible roster
Beaufort positive-direction validation passes if Beaufort remains measurable
continuation_to_demographic_model.then: freeze exact demographic likelihood, observation-error propagation, regional temporal adjustment, and inferential calibration before rejoining count magnitudes
